blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transport group Samahang Manibela, Mananakay at Nagkaisang Terminal ng Transportasyon (Manibela) began its two-day strike on Monday to protest the supposed leadership change at the Land Transportation Office (LTO). READ: WALANG PASOK: In-person classes, court operation suspensions on Nov. 23 Manibela members, led by president Mar Valbuena, marched and staged a demonstration in front of the Land Transportation Office’s (LTO) central office in Quezon City. The group launched the strike to protest the supposed removal of LTO Chief Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao. According to Valbuena, Manibela was among those who witnessed the reforms Lacanilao implemented at the agency. […]... Keep on reading: Manibela begins two-day transport strike
